Package com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.event

Class PhasedEvent

java.lang.Object
org.bukkit.event.Event
com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.event.AbstractQSEvent
com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.event.PhasedEvent
All Implemented Interfaces:
QSCancellable, org.bukkit.event.Cancellable
Direct Known Subclasses:
ControlComponentGenerateEvent, ShopEvent, ShopSettingEvent
public abstract class PhasedEvent extends AbstractQSEvent implements QSCancellable
PhasedEvent represents an event that has different phases, and is called during different lifecycles.

6.2.0.9
